sentences.en: The boy had been crying until he got some candy.
sentences.zh: 这个男孩哭了直到他得到了一些糖果。

sentences.en: Emily has such a sweet tooth she never refuses candy.
sentences.zh: 艾米莉非常喜欢甜食，从不拒绝吃糖果。

sentences.en: If you are a good girl, you shall have candy.
sentences.zh: 如果你表现得好，你就会得到糖果。

senses.zh: 用糖煮；使结晶为砂糖；美化 -
糖果（等于sweets）；冰糖（等于sugar candy，rock candy）；[俚]毒品 -
[俚]新潮的（服饰）；[古]甜言蜜语的
